decision.observation: 8 mph, gear 1, four light-blue dots lit, no red X. The car has drifted off the lane's left edge and sits on dark grass; the tarmac band with a chain of big blue puddles runs up-right toward the red buildings and the arched structure at the top.
decision.hypothesis: The car left the lane on the outside of the right-hand bend. The lane is only a short way to the right, so a throttle-right hold should put it back on the tarmac before the puddle chain.
decision.memory: Red buildings and the white arch mark the lane heading beyond this bend; the outside-left grass here is where the car overshoots at speed.
